parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of whitelist rules to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: **20**, which indicates that 20 whitelist rules are displayed on each page.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The asset search keyword. You can enter the IP address, public IP address, private IP address, or asset name for fuzzy matching.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.
